evidence_documents.title: Twilight Time (The Moody Blues song)
evidence_documents.text: "Twilight Time" is a song from The Moody Blues' 1967 album "Days of Future Passed". It is the final of three songs on the album representing the evening, along with "(Evening) Time to Get Away" (which is actually on "The Afternoon" track), and "The Sunset." Written by the Moody Blues' flautist Ray Thomas, "Twilight Time" primarily describes the scene in the sky after the sun has set.
